sources.label: Modality-specific neurovascular coupling via layer-segregated arteriole networks · Science (2026)

research.summary: Rain stipples the surface overhead. Below, a ribbon of kelp curls around a pebble. In mice, different sensory inputs recruit different types of cortical arterioles. Which vessels dilate, and how they connect, helps determine the pattern of blood flow across cortical layers.

title: Listening to Rain in a Tide Pool · 潮池听雨
